description: Score a .glb or .gltf for the web: geometry (normals, winding, degenerate triangles), materials, performance (triangles, draw calls, texture memory against web budgets), loading (extensions three.js does not support, decoders needed), size and origin; with `archetype` (an id or a name such as 'car' or 'helikopter') also whether it is what it should be: parts, pivots, wheel axes, size, direction. Read-only.

detail.description: brief (capped, short) or full (everything); default brief

path.description: Project folder, or a file or folder in it (relative to the server's folder; default: the project).

name: three_model_lint
title: Score a model for three.js
